checks.name: covered-scope
checks.detail: Removal of non-owned flood-borne debris (stones) from underneath the insured building to the perimeter of the building in the yard

checks.name: excluded-scope
checks.detail: Cost to remove non-owned flood-borne debris from the yard; expense to ship non-owned flood-borne debris by barge for further handling and disposal; increased cost to remove non-owned debris in the yard or cart debris from the perimeter into a barge

checks.name: price-support
checks.detail: Additional evidence that the estimated dollar amount from the contractor is limited to the covered scope of work; other debris removal estimates from one or more different contractors; proof of repairs and price from previous flood claims related to removing stones and debris from underneath the building; cost paid to remove debris from the yard even though not covered under SFIP

checks.name: prior-claim-overlap
checks.detail: Review documentation in file for policyholder's previous claims with debris removal; verify that debris removal for the same area underneath the building was performed before the July 2019 flood event
